problem: Construct the perpendicular to an infinite straight line AB from an external point P.

proof_idea.original: The source uses a circle centered at the external point, its two intersections with the line, and the midpoint of the resulting chord.
proof_idea.analytic: Project P onto AB using t=dot(AP,AB)/norm(AB)^2. Check line membership and dot-zero perpendicularity; external-point hypothesis excludes equality with the projection.

litex_code:
thm proposition_12:
    ? forall a, b, p cart(R, R):
        a != b
        not $geometry::main::is_on_line(p, a, b)
        =>:
            exist f cart(R, R) st {$geometry::main::is_on_line(f, a, b), p != f, $geometry::main::is_perpendicular(p, f, a, b)}
    release thm geometry::main::point_difference_norm_pos(a, b)
    have norm_sq R+ = (b(1) - a(1))^2 + (b(2) - a(2))^2
    have projection R = (p(1) - a(1)) * (b(1) - a(1)) + (p(2) - a(2)) * (b(2) - a(2))
    have t R = projection / norm_sq
    have foot cart(R, R) = (a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1)), a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2)))
    foot(1) = a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1))
    foot(2) = a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2))
    foot(1) - a(1) = (a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1))) - a(1) = t * (b(1) - a(1))
    foot(2) - a(2) = (a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2))) - a(2) = t * (b(2) - a(2))
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, foot), geometry::main::vec(a, b)) = (foot(1) - a(1)) * (b(2) - a(2)) - (foot(2) - a(2)) * (b(1) - a(1)) = (t * (b(1) - a(1))) * (b(2) - a(2)) - (t * (b(2) - a(2))) * (b(1) - a(1)) = 0
    release obj def geometry::main::line_through_points
    foot $in geometry::main::line_through_points(a, b)
    by def $geometry::main::is_on_line(foot, a, b)
    projection = (projection / norm_sq) * norm_sq = t * norm_sq
    (p(1) - a(1)) * (b(1) - a(1)) + (p(2) - a(2)) * (b(2) - a(2)) = t * ((b(1) - a(1))^2 + (b(2) - a(2))^2)
    release thm geometry::main::foot_perp_parametric(a, b, p, foot, t)
    by contra:
        ? p != foot
        p = foot
        $geometry::main::is_on_line(p, a, b)
        impossible not $geometry::main::is_on_line(p, a, b)
    by def $geometry::main::is_perpendicular(p, foot, a, b)
    witness exist f cart(R, R) st {$geometry::main::is_on_line(f, a, b), p != f, $geometry::main::is_perpendicular(p, f, a, b)} from foot
